title: This Connecticut Airbnb Has a Swim Spa and Unreal Waterfront Views - NewsBreak
text:
By Jasmine Vieau ,
6 hours ago
In my opinion, some vacation rentals are worth staying put for. This cottage on Lake Garda in Burlington is one of them. There’s a massive jetted swim spa on the back deck with the lake stretched out in front of it, a stone fire pit down at the water’s edge, and a private dock where the kayaks and a pedal boat are tied up and ready to go. The evenings practically plan themselves, and you’re tucked into the Farmington Valley with excellent local dining nearby and skiing at Ski Sundown just 20 minutes away. It’s easily one of the best water feature Airbnbs in Connecticut, and one weekend here is all it takes to lose track of time completely.
Photo by Feyza, courtesy of Airbnb Lakefront Cozy Cottage — Burlington, Connecticut The cottage dates back to the 1930s as a classic summer vacation escape and has been fully renovated, so the character is genuine while the amenities are completely modern. Spanning 1,080 square feet, the single-level layout features three bedrooms that comfortably sleep four guests.
Photo by Feyza, courtesy of Airbnb Throughout the common spaces, whitewashed exposed beams and a floor-to-ceiling stone fireplace ground the main living area, which flows directly into a kitchen outfitted with stainless steel appliances and a proper breakfast bar. The dining area sits along a wide run of windows facing the lake, so a slow morning coffee with a view feels like the natural way to start the day.
A Swim Spa and Fire Pit at the Water’s Edge The year-round swim spa on the back deck is what truly elevates this property among waterfront Airbnbs in Connecticut. Because it faces straight out over Lake Garda with zero obstructions, you can swim against the currents or soak in the warm, jetted water with the tree line and open lake completely framing your view.
Photo by Feyza, courtesy of Airbnb In the colder months, that scenery shifts into something remarkably quiet. Guests frequently write about sitting in the steaming spa while watching the snow fall over a frozen lake. Below the deck, a paved stone patio leads to a custom fire pit surrounded by Adirondack chairs right by the waterline, while the private dock extends out over the lake. The water access here is functional and immersive, not just decorative.
Photo by Feyza, courtesy of Airbnb A Luxury Retreat That Works in Every Season While it feels like a secluded oasis, the cabin is perfectly suited to the modern traveler. The living room features a 55-inch HDTV loaded with Netflix, Disney+, and Max, and a dedicated workspace pairs with verified 224 Mbps Wi-Fi. It holds up just as beautifully for a focused remote work week as it does for a luxury weekend getaway.
Because Ski Sundown is only a 20-minute drive away, it doubles as a premier winter destination. Coming back from a day on the slopes to a lakefront fire and a warm soak in the swim spa is a hard itinerary to argue with.
Photo by Feyza, courtesy of Airbnb Highly rated by guests as a “Top 1%” home on the platform, the property has earned a near-flawless rating. Visitors consistently praise the hosts’ attention to detail, the pristine outdoor spaces, and how effortlessly the cottage delivers on its promises. It is best for couples looking for a true break from the noise, small groups or families who want to spend actual time outside, or remote workers looking for a premium change of scenery.
Photo by Feyza, courtesy of Airbnb There aren’t many water feature Airbnbs in Connecticut where the calendar genuinely fills up for a reason. The Cozy Cottage on Lake Garda has the swim spa, the fire pit, the dock, and a host with stellar ratings to back it all up. If the dates you want are open, book them .
If you’re planning a longer trip through the state, our Connecticut waterfalls guide is worth a look for scenic stops nearby. And if you’re still exploring options, this Airbnb with a hot tub in Connecticut (my favorite!) and this luxury Airbnb in Connecticut are both great places to start.
